name: Check agent shell commands in Docker with a shared file workspace
description: An AI agent runs shell commands in a Docker container and uses File System Tools on the same workspace: a file made in the shell is read by the file tools and the other way around. It also checks a failing command, a background process and the container's HOME.
shortDescription: Shell commands in Docker and the file tools work on the same agent workspace.
keyFeatures: Shell Tools with the Docker execution backend
Files shared between the shell and File System Tools
Failing command and background process handling
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.shell.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_SHELL_ENABLED), which turns on Shell Tools
Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.file-system.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED), which turns on the File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools
Docker or Podman CLI on the ByteChef server's PATH
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who want to check how the Agent Utils file and shell tools behave before they let agent builders use them.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent runs shell commands and file tool calls on the shared /workspace.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
